comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this. The current issue points to the new Keyboard Manager interface exiting unexpectedly, but it does not yet identify whether this is a crash, a UI close, a setup/install boundary, or a Keyboard Manager initialization failure.

Please provide:

1. Reproduce the unexpected exit and comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward so the diagnostic ZIP captures the same session.
2. Numbered steps from opening PowerToys/Keyboard Manager to the exit, including whether it happens every time and whether Settings or the tray icon remain usable afterward.
3. If Windows logged an Application Error at the same time, copy the Event Viewer details, especially the faulting application/module and exception code.
